description: PROP-204b is one of the 26 Tier>0 PROP IDs the contract's own 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section explicitly lists as 'targeted for closure this sprint'. Its own verification method (verification-architecture.md PROP-204b row) requires: 'structural read of the funding-amount constant/formula; integration test confirms the transferred amount matches the documented sizing formula, not an arbitrary/larger figure'. As established in FIND-006, no gas-seed transfer call site exists ANYWHERE in spawn-orchestrator.mjs's real execution path -- seedUsdcAmount() is read only into a ledger bookkeeping field, never passed to any transfer mechanism. There is consequently no 'transferred amount' for any integration test to confirm against the sizing formula, because no transfer of any kind is ever attempted. This is the identical failure pattern CRIT-205's own passThreshold names as a direct FAIL condition: 'FAIL if any of the 31 names a call site that does not exist in the current implementation, is unreachable, or is a stub/placeholder'. Separately, PROP-201a is proved (assertRealEvmAddress genuinely exists and is tested, resolving round-2 FIND-003a), but its sibling PROP-201c -- ALSO one of the 26 targeted-for-closure PROP IDs -- is not: PROP-201c's own verification method requires 'Tier 0: structural read of the calling code confirms stdout is redirected directly to a file path, never piped through any logging wrapper; Tier 2: a real invocation's gen-wallet.sh output file has mode 0600 and lives under the child's own home'. An independent read of defaultGenerateEvmWallet (spawn-orchestrator.mjs lines 145-150) confirms the private key is captured via execFileSync's own in-memory stdout return value (`const out = execFileSync(...); const {address, private_key: privateKey} = JSON.parse(out);`) -- NEVER redirected to any file, 600-perm or otherwise, at any point in its lifetime; it is held purely in the Node.js process's own memory for the full duration of executeSpawnAttempt (passed through evmWallet.privateKey to defaultRegisterIdentity, never written to disk by ensureAgentId/ensure-agent-id.mjs either, confirmed by direct read -- that module's own cacheFile only ever persists {address, agentId}, never the key). This is a genuine architecture mismatch against PROP-201c's own named mechanism, not merely an unpromoted-but-provable obligation: no code path in the current implementation performs a file redirect of this material at all, so no read of 'the calling code' can confirm the Tier-0 half, and no real invocation can produce a 0600 output file to check for the Tier-2 half (arguably the in-memory-only approach is a MORE conservative security posture than PROP-201c's own file-based design, but that is a reason to correct verification-architecture.md's own text, not a substitute for it currently existing).

evidence.lineRange: 145-150 (defaultGenerateEvmWallet, PROP-201c); 50-55, 236-241 (PROP-204b, see FIND-006 for full evidence)
